nom: Borghese Effetto Immediato Spa Soothing Tonic

avis.texte: I love my Effetto Immediato Tonic! It always leaves my face ready for moisturizer.
Love this product. I have used it for years and do recommend it.
I love this tonic as it makes my skin feel clean and fresh, free from any soap residue and ready for my cura forte! I have tried other brands but this is the best one for me.

So smooth and cooling, removes the extra cleanser after washing your face at night. Or it can be used as a separate cleanser in the morning, so that it does not strip your natural oils produced during sleep. Light botanical scent . . .
I hadn't used for Borghese products for years. Im happy that I've started again. Im 73 years old and I've received compliments about my skin. Im delighted.
This tonic is great after cleansing your skin. So cooling and relaxing. Follow with moisturizer makes my skin so soft. Love it!!
Feels so good before bedtime and 1st thing in the morning after cleansing
This is soothing. Not only do I use it as a toner, but also as a comforting after-shave! The light spa scent is very pleasing and this makes a great skin preparation for Ristorativo!

I never really thought about using a tonic until I was introduced to Borghese products years ago. It is so effective, calming, and delightful to use. I actually put my in a small spray bottle and spritz it on my face. Wow, like a lovely wake up to my skin. I can't be without it. It is an essential part of my daily routine and have made a HUGE difference to my skin. No residue.
This toner feels refreshing on my clean skin and tightens pores leaving to feel my facial skin smooth and even tone looking.

I am using this cleansing for the first time.I use it after I clean my face with Borghese product. I use it both at bedtime and in the morning after I have cleaned my face. I am amazed at the slight residue that remains on my face, but this cleanser removes it to a squeaky clean feeling. I highly recommend this product for anyone who seeks clean facial before applying makeup in the a.m. or at bedtime before applying night cream.
Perfect addition to use with the creme saponetta cleanser. My skin does not look my age. This toner doesn't burn or sting nor does the formula dry my skin. Essential part of my skincare routine.
Effetto Immediato feels so good. As you spray it on, it cools your skin and makes you feel alive. I couple it with Cura Forte and I believe my face is ready for the world.

After using Crema Saponetta to cleanse my face, I use this tonic to further refresh my skin. I love the way it makes my skin feel. It is cool and light and removes any residue that may remain after rinsing. Plus, applying my moisturizers afterwards ia a smooth and even process. A definite keeper.
I love how this tonic is absorbed and leaves no sticky residue.
I love the Effetto for setting my make up. I never use powder as a finisher just Effetto.
I've been using this for years. I love it! I use my own spray bottle to apply it.

Love this Spa Soothing Tonic. Very pleasant to use, refreshing, no ittitation. Borghese just the best. WISH tbe entire line would cone back, but I understand that there are ingredients which are difficult, or impossible, to now obtain so ad to hsve the original formulas which give Borghese its effective skincare. If this is accurate, very sad.
I love the soothing tonic, as well as all of Borghese products. I only wish that the products were more available in department stores.
I have used this product for years and love it. Leaves my face feeling fresh and clean, ready for the cura forte and moisturizer. Thank you for a great product!

This is without a doubt the best skin tonic on the market. I recently went out of town and forgot mine. I couldn't wait to get back home to it again. It takes all the dullness and dry skin away. Love this stuff and have used it for years.

Been using this toner since 2005! It's calming, soothing and refreshing. I use this after my Crema Saponetta and before my CuraForte. My skin always looks clear and luminous! A spa classic from Borghese!
Love this product. Hope it never gets discontinued like the deep hydration finishing treatment.
I love all of your products. I have been using them for about 50 years. Everyone says i don't look my age and i contribute that to your wonderful products.
I love all of your products. The eye cream is amazing and it reduces the wrinkles under my eyes. I will always do all of my ordering from you. I have been a customer for 25 years now.
One of the only products I trust for my skin. I have used nothing else for 25 years.
Best tonic I ever used. I'm an aesthetician and this is my personal favorite. Pro tip: I mist this on my skin as a finishing mist.

I've been using Borghese Products for approximately 40 years. My recent purchase of the Effetto Immediate Spa soothing tonic was to continue to use it. It's refreshing to use after washing my face. I feel like it soothes some of the harshness of the face wash.

avis.titre: The perfect base step for your Borghese skin care routine
avis.texte: I have been using this soothing skin tonic, as part of my Borghese skin care routine, for several years. It is a wonderful product for perfect skin preparation. I just pour the slightest amount into my cupped hand, and then with both hands, lightly pat it over my face. Then once it dries, which is quickly, I can go to the next skin care step. In my book, this is a must, and cannot be skipped.
I love the Spa Soothing Tonic! I feel instantly refreshed and brightened every time I use it.

I love this product but glad I saved the atomizer bottle it used to come in. Please package it that way again. By the way, I am 90 years old with hardly a wrinkle after 35 years of using Borghese products. No bags under the eyes or crows feet. Carole
DUE TO MY AGE MY FACE IS DRY. THAT TONER WORKED VERY EFFECTIVELY FOR ME. I am very pleased with the outcome.
Love the tonic however, the spout doesn't open very well and I'm losing tonic. Wish I could get another top.
My skin is sensitive. And I use this lotion more than 20 years Wonderful product..

I love this toner and have been using it since 2005. It is super gentle, hydrating and refreshing! It does have a fresh spa scent despite the description saying it is fragrance free but it is very light and only adds the the experience. i always use this after washing my face with Crema Saponetta and then follow with my CuraForte and moisturizer. Its perfect!
Great toner I've used for years! It's fragrance free & feels good too! Highly recommend!

I love this toner its very cool and soothing on my sensitive skin. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and hydrated. I always use after I cleanse to restore a healthy glow and to reduce that tignt feeling.
It's a great toner and I use it on cuts or blemishes. My husband uses it on his oily, bald head twice a day. Great stuff. I wish it came back in a spray bottle.

I have been using Borghese for nearly 50 years. I have never been disappointed in their products. I receive compliments on my skin all the time. People can't believe I am 70 years old. The only complaint I have Borghese products are no longer available in stores.

I have been using Borghese for 40+ years and I am 84 years old and its fun being 'carded'. There first question is what makeup do you use ? your skin is so beautiful. Proud to tell them the best there is Borghese.
Have been using borghese products for maybe 40 years. Everyone tells me I do not look my age and I say it is borghese products. 😀
Best product ever! I faithfully use this in my daily morning routine.
It still works but a 4 Star instead of a 5 Star because it no longer comes in a spray bottle. The application is not as convenient in the bottle it now comes in.
Love your products, have been using for over 40 yrs. Please bring back the spray bottle, new bottle is so impractical and wasteful.

avis.titre: The best toner on the market
avis.texte: For amazingly balanced skin without the dryness I highly recommend this toner. It never dries out your skin but cleanses and balances it to perfection.
Perfect solution for removing last traces of makeup. Non drying and no filmy residue
It's been awhile sense I've used this product. As I remember I really thought it was a great product. Wish we had a place your products were sold locally. We did at one time.

Amazing Product within 2 days of using the soothing tonic I noticed an immediate change in the texture of my skin. There was a softening of lines in the delicate area of the eyes. I think this product is great and now that I have tried it will continue to use it to firm and counteract the visible signs of aging particularily around the eyes.

avis.titre: Sad and disappointed ... this WAS a great product.
avis.texte: I have loved this product for decades. Now the SCENT is RADICALLY different, and I dislike it immensely. After drying on my face, it feels STICKY. I give credit to your products for keeping my facial skin soft and supple, but I'll be looking for a different toner after this bottle is empty. So very sad why did you change the formulation? PUT IT BACK, and bring back the SCENT with it!
It is very refreshing If you need a spray bottle, go buy one, don't take it out on the effects of the product.

I agree with all of the others. The spray bottle is much better for you Bring back the spray bottle!!!!! Using your hands only invites bacteria on your face tyrion on your face. Why can't you offer both?

I love this product so much, it's pure perfection for my skin! I stopped using toners about a year ago because they were irritating causing redness + drying- thought I'd give it go again and I am so happy I did!! My face is glowing five stars!

I never sprayed this on my face anyway. I took the top off, poured a little in my hand, and patted it on my face. Product is wonderful. After cleansing and before Curaforte is an unbeatable combination. Have been doing this for nearly 40 years. Lots of favorable comments on my skin.
I've always loved this toner or tonic, but I use it all over my body and a cotton ball won't work. Please let me know when you bring back the spray bottle. Thank you

avis.titre: All changes have been poor choices
avis.texte: It seems in all changes, by Borghese company, have been to cut the product in half while changing the packaging. I am buying so little of Borghese, finding substitutes for the Borghese product. It saddens me because I love the aroma, at Cetera of Borghese, but I just can't tolerate these changes. No company, no person, nothing is irreplaceable and it seems Borghese does not value it's American patrons.
I have been using this product for 20 plus years, always sprayed. I saved one of my old bottles and poured the new product in. Many changes not for the good.

avis.titre: Only toner that works for me
avis.texte: I have very difficult skin with a tendency to redness. I do pour this into a clean empty spray bottle for application, but my face has never looked better. Clean, soft, no redness or irritation.

Giving it 1-star because of the new packaging. Still the same awesome tonic. I kept the spray in my fridge and would use it any time my skin needed that extra kick especially after being outside. Please bring back the spray as using a cotton is not very convenient.

Please bring back the soothing tonic spray. I have used for years and have never found a product that I like as much. I like putting on my moisturizer while my face is still moist from the spray. This is impossible with a cotton ball. I also l spray the tonic to refresh my make up and especially love to use the spray to moisten my skin while travelling by plane. Why fix a product that is not broken! Please listen to your customers!
Please give us back the spa soothing tonic spray. I always kept it in the fridge and it was the best thing for winter dryness from HAVAC and summer heat or beach. Please! You may have both products.

avis.titre: Bring back spa soothing tonic SPRAY
avis.texte: Please bring back the spa soothing tonic spray - it is wonderful, light and easy to use anytime, anywhere

I used the toner spray for years. The spray was light with just a little tang to it and got me moving every single morning. I have been searching for a long time and finally found it (I don't remember which website) but as soon as I used it I knew it was expired, it was flat, no special experience there. If this were a spray I would have bought at least two bottles. I don't want to use a pad and waste product. I want to feel the spray lightly on my face. Why make this decision? I can't imagine a focus group would have thought it was a good idea. Like many of your other customers, have said in their reviews, you have lost my business for this products and I have to look for something else. Please consider the voice of your customer.
Been using the Tonico minerale since high school and love the refreshing mist! Hate using Cotton pads which absorb all the tonic. Please bring back the spray!!! The most was perfect! Easy to use too!

avis.titre: Please bring back the toner spray bottle
avis.texte: I am a long time faithful customer, I discovered the product in my 30's and am now in my 70's. The spa products and the toner spray were my basics in skin care and as I aged I always the found the perfect great skin care for my age. Many friends would be amazed when I'd tell them my age because of how great my skin was. I tried toners that you needed to use pads to use however it just does not work as well. I do hope you will reconsider and bring it back. The spa products get a 5 star from me but this type of toner only a 2.

As I've gotten older I've started getting bad scarring from random breakouts; they would leave behind bright red spots on my skin that I couldn't get rid of no matter what I tried. Recently I've started using the Fango Uniforme mask twice a week, and this toner every morning and every night after I wash my face and the spots are almost 100% gone. I am so, SO pleased with the results and recommend it to everyone I know with the same skin concerns!

avis.titre: Nothing like the discontinued Tonico Minerale
avis.texte: I used the now discontinued Tonico Minerale for years and it was perfect for my combination skin. This product is an overpriced, wimpy alternative, so I was forced to switch to another brand.
I loved the toner spray. It was a fine mist and was wonderfully refreshing. Why change to a cotton pad application?

I've been using Borghese products as my main product for over 20 years and love it with the exception of the recent changes that I'm not happy with. I'm not sure why they changed Spa Soothing Tonic from a spray bottle to a non spray because the effects are not the same. By spraying it was a perfect even mist I was getting on the face and neck. The new directions to use a cotton pad is absolutely horrible because you are wasting more product and dabbing on the skin with the cotton pad does not give the effect of fresh feeling and by the time I'm finished dabbing the product has dried. Anyways applying the moisturizer aftwards does not absorb as good as spraying the tonic.
I am so happy this product is back!! I am also waiting energica day cream or like cura-c cream firming skin cream back
